summary: Lloyds Banking Group plc filed a Form 6-K disclosing a routine open-market share purchase of 5,000,000 ordinary shares at a volume-weighted average price of 109.2098 pence per share, executed by Goldman Sachs International under an existing buyback programme announced on 30 January 2026. The shares will be cancelled. This is a standard capital-return activity under a previously announced programme, not a special-situation event. No board recommendation, advisor, or structural novelty is present. The filing represents a routine issuer buyback, not a tender offer or activist campaign.
